extraction_focus: Pay close attention to customer names, account identifiers, specific error messages or symptoms, workarounds provided, escalation paths, and resolution steps. Capture SLA deadlines when mentioned.
compaction_preserve: Customer names and account details, specific error symptoms and reproduction steps, workarounds and resolutions, escalation contacts, SLA timestamps.
compaction_compress: General product explanations, repeated FAQ answers, resolved tickets with no ongoing relevance.
